title: Guaranteed Rate Field HVAC / AHU Renovation - Phase IX
scope: Complete ground truth for all thirteen supplied Guaranteed Rate Field HVAC/AHU Renovation Phase IX sheets: exact title-block/project/sheet review; all twenty rows and 421 cells in M3.01's eight schedules; all eleven explicitly printed M4.02 typical-points rows; specific BAS wiring, integration, safety and limited sequence text; M2.01's valve-chart sample distinction; and source conflict/reconciliation ledgers. No unprinted installed I/O total, controller terminal count, protocol, network topology, control-valve schedule, individual FCU-5 identities or unresolved tag/location alias is invented.
reading_notes: All thirteen supplied pages were reviewed as full-page 180 DPI Poppler renders. MuPDF and Poppler independently corroborate each authored schedule/points cell and bounded text assertion.
M3.01 has eight populated schedules / 20 rows. FCU-5's literal QTY cell is 11; it remains one source schedule row plus an explicit source quantity rather than eleven fabricated location tags.
The populated Automatic Control Damper Schedule has exactly ACD 1 and ACD 2. Both print fail CLOSED. Its note assigns dampers to MC and listed-fail-position actuators to BASC.
M4.02's fan-coil and air-handling-unit lists are expressly TYPICAL. Their 11 source rows are preserved as templates, not multiplied by schedule or plan items into an installed I/O count.

M2.01's VALVE TAG AND VALVE CHART SAMPLE is deliberately excluded as a populated project control-valve schedule. The M3.01 Refrigeration Schedule's CH 1 versus the Chiller Schedule's CH 2, and FCU-1's source-location conflict, remain unresolved source discrepancies.

requirement_audit.finding: Project name, Chicago site, project number and issued-for-bid date are captured from repeated title blocks; blank revision-log structure is not treated as an event.
Every supplied page has exact title and sheet-number witnesses plus a full-page visual finding.
M0.02/M0.03/M0.04 print 1/32" = 1'-0"; M1 sheets are VARIES and details/schedules/specifications are AS NOTED, so title-block scale is not treated as a global conversion where it is non-specific.

All 20 schedule-row identities are classified, with 12 non-reference physical/assembly anchors. Outlet types, coordination categories and refrigeration cross-references remain outside a field-device total.
All cells of the 20 rows in eight M3.01 schedules are retained: chiller, FCU, automatic-control damper, condensing unit, outlet, DX coil, coordination and refrigeration schedules.

Eleven exact source rows in two TYPICAL M4.02 points lists are retained. Prose-level BASC/EC/MC obligations are captured but no per-row physical owner, terminal, controller or installed I/O multiplication is supplied.
All work is incorporated into the existing Siemens BAS and graphically represented there; protocol, transport, controller model, addressing and topology are not stated.
Specific FCU-1 OA-damper, fire/smoke shutdown and water-coil freeze-protection behaviors are retained. No universal standalone sequence is inferred for every scheduled unit.
Typical temperature/wall-switch/thermostat roles and BASC sensor-placement requirements are recorded; neither physical count nor location-tagged zone mapping is stated.
The M2.01 valve chart is a sample, not a populated control-valve schedule. M3.01 contains a two-row ACD schedule; schedule tag/location discrepancies are preserved without aliasing.
All thirteen supplied pages were reviewed at full-page resolution; saved Poppler renders and concise page dispositions are embedded and hash-checked.
Bundle build and validation rerun every authored module against retained MuPDF and Poppler captures, then record current source/manifest/module digests.

controls_context.module_role: M4.02 controls, safety, integration, wiring and sequence context. This records the supplied written requirements without converting typical lists or prose responsibilities into an unprinted installed controller/terminal roster.

network_architecture.existing_system: Existing Siemens building automation system currently in operation within Guaranteed Rate Field
network_architecture.integration_requirement: All project work shall be incorporated into the existing Siemens BAS; all control items indicated below shall be provided in graphic form on the building BAS system.

basc: All low-voltage control wiring, power wiring and conduit associated with control valves, actuators and controllers installed as part of the project.
May reuse compatible existing relays/current sensing relays/current transducers; reused conduit, wiring, sensors or switches must be tested before use and included in the project warranty.
Hard-wired control points are mapped to system graphics for building-staff viewing.
Adequate bid time for complete on-site commissioning with the mechanical contractor and other trades.
ownership_and_wiring.electrical_contractor: Furnishes/installs smoke and/or heat detectors in air supply systems over 2000 CFM and the addressable fire-alarm relay; the BAS contractor picks up the relay signal.
ownership_and_wiring.source_boundary: M3.01 separately assigns the scheduled automatic dampers to MC and the listed-fail-position actuators to BASC. No row-level assignment is printed for the two M4.02 typical point lists.

sequence_of_operations.source_behavior: Outdoor-air ductwork and associated motorized damper; OA damper shall only open to the indicated CFM after proof of FCU operation.
BAS picks up the addressable fire-alarm relay signal, stops the supply fan when interlocked fire/smoke is sensed, and the DDC program shows a fire-in-unit alarm at shutdown.

BASC furnishes/installs manual-reset safety devices; each water coil has a downstream averaging-element freeze-stat with non-adjustable 40°F setpoint, manual reset and hardwired fan-shutdown interlock when any 12-inch element length is below 40°F.

sensor_and_zone_ledger.source_typed_roles: M4.02's two lists print fan-coil/air-handling discharge-air temperature, AHU return-air temperature, occupied wall switch and thermostat context; they are typical list rows rather than location-tagged installed sensor quantities.
sensor_and_zone_ledger.placement_requirement: Temperature and pressure sensors must avoid false readings; BASC reviews plans, reports potential causes before rough-in and relocates improperly located false-reading sensors at its expense.

source_limitations: The supplied set has two explicitly labeled typical points lists, not an equipment-instance matrix, controller schedule, panel terminal list, network point export, or installed I/O total.
No communications protocol, transport, controller/panel model, address, baud rate, network topology or per-point physical owner is printed.
M4.02 contains specific behaviors for FCU-1 OA damper, fire/smoke shutdown and coil freeze protection, but not a system-wide standalone written sequence for every scheduled unit.
